extracted.name: Rocky Road Cookies
extracted.description: Soft, chewy chocolate cookies loaded with gooey mini marshmallows, melty chocolate chips, and crunchy pecans. They taste like a rocky road ice cream in cookie form—rich, fudgy, and full of texture in every bite.

yield.unit: cookie per person * makes 7 large cookies*

ingredient_lines: 3/4 cup (150 g) brown sugar (light or dark)
1/2 cup (113 g) butter, melted and cooled (salted or unsalted)
1 cup (110 g) chopped pecans (or any nuts)
instruction_lines: Mix wet ingredients In a bowl, mix brown sugar, sugar, melted butter, egg, vanilla, and milk until smooth.
Add dry ingredients Add flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, cornstarch, and cocoa powder. Mix just until combined.
Add mix-ins Fold in pecans, marshmallows, and chocolate chips.
Chill dough Refrigerate dough for at least 30 minutes.
Cool slightly Let sit on tray a few minutes before moving so marshmallows don’t tear.
